verses.gurmukhi: ਘੁਘੂ ਚਾਮਚਿੜਕ ਨੋ ਦੇਹੁਂ ਨ ਸੁਝੈ ਚਾਨਣ ਹੋਂਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: ghughoo chaamachiRak no dhehu(n) na sujhai chaanan ho(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Nothing can be seen by bat and owl in the day light.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਤਿ ਅਨ੍ਹੇਰੀ ਦੇਖਦੇ ਬੋਲੁ ਕੁਬੋਲੁ ਅਬੋਲੁ ਖਲੋਂਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: raat anheree dhekhadhe bol kubol abol khalo(n)dhe|

en.bdb: They see only in the dark night. They keep silent but as and when they speak their sound is evil.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਨ੍ਹੇ ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਹੁਂ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ ਚਕੀ ਝੋਂਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: manmukh a(n)nhe raat dhihu(n) surat vihoone chakee jho(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Manmukhs also remain blind day and night and being devoid of consciousness go on operating the quern of discord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਉਗੁਣ ਚੁਣਿ ਚੁਣਿ ਛਡਿ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਹੀਰੇ ਫਟਕ ਪਰੋਂਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: aaugun chun chun chhadd gun parahar heere faTak paro(n)dhe|

en.bdb: They pick up demerits and leave out merits; they reject the diamond and prepare the string of stones.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਸੁਜਾਖੇ ਅੰਨੑਹਿਆਂ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦ ਮਤਵਾਲੇ ਰੋਂਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: naau sujaakhe a(n)n(h)hiaa(n) maiaa madh matavaale ro(n)dhe|

en.bdb: These blind ones are called sujOns, the learned and intelligent ones. Inebrigated with the pride of their wealth they wail and weep.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕਰੋਧ ਵਿਰੋਧ ਵਿਚਿ ਚਾਰੇ ਪਲੇ ਭਰਿ ਭਰਿ ਧੋਂਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: kaam karodh virodh vich chaare pale bhar bhar dho(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Engrossed in lust, anger and antagonism they wash the four corners of their stained sheet.
They never get liberated from carrying the load of their stony sins.
